title: fleet parking_lot_member row v1
description: ONE ROW OF THE parking_lot_member TABLE (work-data-ssot-audit-2026-10-19): one session in one lot, primary key (lot_id, session_id). The columns are the audit's. The session's label, role, folder and pane belong to the session table and are not repeated here; fleet/Hibernation.ps1's record.json carries them. state: parked, woken, or dropped (it never slept, so it left the park). Whether a member is ASLEEP is not stored: it is membership together with whether its process runs. A column that is not known is left out, never null. File: parking_lot_member.json beside parking_lot.json.

session_id.description: The harness's own session id, a lower-case uuid.

note.description: The path of its PARKED-<label>.md, when the file was there.
